WITH total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS total_artifacts
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    articount,
    CAST(articount AS REAL) / (SELECT total_artifacts FROM total_count) AS share
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
    AND (SELECT total_artifacts FROM total_count) IS NOT NULL
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  articount,
  share,
  share - (SELECT average_share FROM avg_calc) AS difference
FROM with_shares
WHERE (SELECT average_share FROM avg_calc) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
